non_claim_boundary: Repository-local post-recompute observation and ruling; outcomes determine whether material cascade justified or promotion remains authority-local only.

observation_questions.text: Have any recompute surfaces moved beyond PENDING_RECOMPUTE state?
For completed recompute surfaces, do completed outputs show actual state/value change vs. pre-promotion baseline?
Is observed state change attributable to the revised blocker definition promotion?

possible_rulings.condition: completed recompute surfaces show actual state change AND change attributable to promotion
possible_rulings.interpretation: Material cascade confirmed; promotion propagated from authority surface through recompute graph and produced downstream state changes

possible_rulings.condition: recompute surfaces completed but show no measurable state change OR insufficient downstream signal
possible_rulings.interpretation: Promotion remains authority-local; trigger propagation confirmed but no material cascade observed in downstream outputs

possible_rulings.condition: surfaces still in PENDING_RECOMPUTE or incomplete; insufficient data to rule
possible_rulings.interpretation: Recompute not yet complete; material cascade determination deferred pending recompute completion

cascade_assessment_criteria.description: Did QM seam coherence metric values change post-promotion?
Did ledger artifact transport behavior change post-promotion?
cascade_assessment_criteria.materiality_threshold: observable flux pattern or state transition change

declaration.fail_closed_rule: Default to RECOMPUTE_STILL_PENDING unless completed recompute outputs are available and show measurable change
declaration.layer_description: Post-recompute observation and ruling layer. Checks completed recompute outputs for actual state change. Rules on whether material cascade occurred or promotion remains authority-local only. Terminal decision layer for cascade determination.
